sector_model: Marketplace under pending cash acquisition: deal terms, spread and regulatory path dominate; standalone GOV, take rate and SBC secondary. Treated as merger situation, not generic value.
thesis: Maplebear (Instacart, Nasdaq: CART) is under a definitive agreement to be acquired by DoorDash (10-Q note, signed 2026-10-28). Per a search summary of the 8-K and 425 filings (documents not opened): 65.00 per share, cash or 0.3372 DoorDash shares or 48.75 cash plus 0.0843 shares, stock capped at 25%, about 17B equity value, 26% premium to the 2026-10-22 close, expected close end 2027 or first half 2028, needs HSR, Canada, Israel and shareholder approval; holders of about 19% have agreed to vote in favor. Close 58.87 on 2026-11-13 (two aggregators agree) leaves a 10.4% gross spread to 65.00 (cash election; stock election moves with DoorDash). Standalone: Q3 revenue 1,095M vs 939M (+17%), net income 147M, EPS 0.60; TTM revenue 4,149M, NI 484M, OCF 1,268M, capex 58M, FCF 1,210M (SBC 440M TTM: 770M after SBC), market cap 13.93B at 236.63M shares: 28.8x TTM, FCF yield 8.7% (5.5% after SBC). Cash 830M plus 105M securities. Conclusion: a stock whose price is anchored to a cash takeover, so ordinary valuation research is not the right lens. It is merger arbitrage with long timing and antitrust risk, not a long term growth or value idea, and the 10% spread over 1 to 1.5 years is compensation for break risk (the pre-deal price was about 51.6 by implication of the 26% premium).
counterthesis: Antitrust review of two leading US delivery platforms could take until 2028 or block the deal; if it breaks the price may fall toward the undisturbed level near 52 (derived from the stated premium, not a read quote). Capital is tied up for 1 to 1.5 years for about 10% gross, before opportunity cost. Upside above 65 is capped. SBC is large. Deal terms were taken from a search summary, not read filings.
invalidation: Interest changes if an HSR second request or regulatory block emerges, the spread widens sharply, or DoorDash financing or votes fail.
